info.title: SmartRateCalcs 2026 Open Fee & Payout Benchmarks API
info.description: Free zero-auth public REST API returning verified 2026 marketplace, payment gateway, and freelance payout fee schedules plus reverse gross-up equations.

get.summary: Retrieve 2026 fee schedules and net payout simulations

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Filter by platform id or name (e.g., reverb, mercari, venmo, ebay, wise).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by Marketplaces, Payment Gateways, or Freelance & Cross-Border.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Sample gross USD sale or invoice amount to simulate net payout and reverse gross-up target.

200.description: Verified 2026 fee schedule array and simulated payout metrics.
